mechanism: Chlorpromazine can cause orthostatic hypotension and has anticholinergic effects that may potentiate the antihypertensive effects of enalapril; both drugs can affect renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for syncope or dizziness, and consider dose adjustment of enalapril if excessive hypotension develops; monitor renal function and electrolytes periodically.
